text: You wonder if this rain will ever let up. It's driven since the month began, perhaps long enough to forget its purpose. It no longer even knows to assuage fire. Somewhere a zealous god threads these strings between the clouds and the earth, preparing for a symphony it fears impossible to play. And so it threads on, and on, delaying the raise of the conductor's baton.
alt: Rose steps outside and peers into the sky. The clouds part, revealing the storm of meteors. The camera pans out to show Rose's home is on the edge of a cliff, with a waterfall running directly through it.
